notes.title: Update VB.2 Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Lexicon fans!

After doing some more testing with y'all, we wanted to adjust some puzzles and fix a gamebreaking bug. 


🐞 Bug Squashing
Entry Naomi Exit Movement
Some players experienced an issue where Naomi wouldn't move completely offscreen after her argument in the Entry. This causes a game breaking circumstance, so we patched her movement to guarantee she leaves the scene.
🧩 Puzzle Improvements
Puzzle Clarity Enhancements
In the crypt, we made the clues a bit easier to identify and adjusted the number 2 puzzle as the sun might not exist in Ekkos. We also adjusted the puzzle in the ironworks as younger audiences had a difficult time understanding base 2 and base 10 number systems.



Please continue to give us feedback through the Steam forums as it helps us make our game better. Thank you for reading! We couldn't do it without you!

notes.title: Update VB.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update brings a few exciting improvements to the Lexicon experience:


✨ New Features
Steam Achievements Added
You can now unlock achievements as you explore the world of Lexicon! Whether you're discovering secrets or progressing through the story, your milestones will now be rewarded.
🧩 Gameplay Improvements
Puzzle Clarity Enhancements
We've updated several puzzles to make their logic and goals more intuitive, based on player feedback. If you found yourself stuck before, give it another shot!
🎨 Visual Fixes
Addressed various minor visual bugs throughout the game



Thank you for playing Lexicon and being part of its journey. Your feedback continues to shape this world—we hope you enjoy the updates!

notes.title: New Domain Release
notes.notes:
Hey Lexicon fans!

We’re excited to share this new update, which expands the game and improves the core experience. 



Here’s what’s new:
New Domain: The Foundry
Continue your journey in The Foundry, a factory world built around efficiency and production.

Explore challenging new environments and uncover more of the Lexicon story.
Physics Overhaul
Completely reworked physics for smoother, more consistent gameplay.

Improved collisions to make movement and interactions feel better than ever.
Level Adjustments
Revised layout of Crypt to be more intuitive and player-friendly.

Took out alternate quest line in Crypt for simplicity.

Added balcony to Nonbeing's Fortress.

Swapped out voices for some collectible cinematics.
Bug Fixes
Smoothed out collision issues and unintended behaviors.

General performance and stability improvements.


⚠️ Important Note on Save Files
Due to the scope of these changes, save data from the previous version is no longer compatible. Returning players will need to "Begin" the game again to experience The Foundry and the latest improvements.

We know this is an inconvenience and appreciate your understanding—it’s helping us make the best version of the game possible!

Thank you for playing, and please keep sending your feedback. It’s incredibly valuable as we continue development!
